job.title: Account Executive / Sales Consultant
job.description:
SMAART Recruitment is partnering with an innovative technology provider in the hospitality space that is changing the way hotels operate behind the scenes.

This is a genuine win-win product. It gives hotels complete operational visibility, saves them time, money and resources, reduces their environmental footprint, and ultimately lifts overall guest satisfaction across the property. Because the commercial and sustainability benefits are so clear, it is a solution hotel leaders actually want to talk about.

We are looking for a driven Sales Consultant / Account Executive to own the full sales cycle. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline, running outreach, leading product demonstrations, managing trials, and guiding new properties through to onboarding and beyond.

You will not be starting from scratch either, as full product and industry training is provided, and solid systems like a HubSpot CRM, and sales collateral are already in place so you can hit the ground running.

What you will be doing:

  • Prospecting and building a healthy pipeline of suitable venues and stakeholders via phone, email, LinkedIn, and inbound leads
  • Running discovery calls to understand a property's current setup, operational challenges, and decision-making process
  • Delivering tailored product demonstrations that clearly show the commercial, operational, and sustainability value of the platform
  • Preparing proposals, negotiating pricing, and setting up structured product trials
  • Handing over successful deals to the implementation team while staying close to the commercial relationship to convert trials into long-term paying customers
  • Keeping HubSpot accurate and up to date with deal stages, pipeline forecasts, and next actions

What we are looking for:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in B2B sales, managing the full cycle from cold outreach through to closing
  • Background in SaaS or tech sales is ideal, and any previous experience in or selling into the hospitality or hotel industry will put you ahead of the pack
  • Confidence picking up the phone, running sharp discovery sessions, and explaining commercial value in plain English
  • A self-starter who thrives in a growing business and enjoys working autonomously while collaborating closely with implementation and leadership teams
  • Strong CRM discipline and consistent follow-through

What is in it for you:

  • Solid base of $80k to $100k + Super + uncapped commission structure depending on experience (OTE $180k)
  • Fully flexible working arrangement, balancing work from home with regular team catch ups at the Carlton office
  • The chance to get out on the road with interstate travel for key customer meetings and industry events
  • Comprehensive onboarding, industry training, and ongoing coaching from a supportive leadership team
  • High-impact, proven product that delivers real financial and environmental wins for your clients

If you are a natural communicator who has wanted to do things their way, loves owning a deal from start to finish and wants to sell a product that makes a real difference, we would love to hear from you.

Hit the Apply button now or for a confidential discussion reach out to Will McPhee at SMAART Recruitment on 03 8637 4411 for a confidential discussion.
